3. Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans (DFSP) — CD34‑positive spindle cell tumor with subcutaneous fat infiltration
4. Chronic expanding/organized hematoma with reactive fibroblastic proliferation (trauma‑related) 
5. Spindle cell lipoma / benign CD34‑positive lipomatous tumor
